key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the pinned number, paired sending, and preparation for Jesus’ own arrival.
key_decisions.before: After this, the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them ahead of him in pairs to every town and place where he himself was about to go.
key_decisions.after: After this, the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them ahead of him in pairs to every town and place he was about to visit.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves repetition of harvest and the strong sending verb.
